name: T6a Source.name reads stored title (W00-R-14); sourceKind OTHER with note (W00-R-08)
query: { sources(where: {uid: {eq: "hu:source:w00-r13-registry"}}) { uid name canonicalUri sourceKind sourceKindNote } }

name: T6b redirect record fields (W00-R-11) read through EquivalenceAssessment
query: { equivalenceAssessments(where: {equivalenceKind: {eq: SAME_IDENTITY_MERGED}}, sort: [{recordedAt: ASC}]) { uid equivalenceKind survivingUid retiredUid recordedAt comparesIdentities { __typename ... on Organization { uid } } } }

name: T6c QUANTITY assertion with object + literal, and statedAsOf (W00-R-02, W00-R-13)
query: { assertions(where: {predicate: {in: ["ACTIVE_MOIETY_AMOUNT", "HOLDS_EQUITY_IN"]}}, sort: [{uid: ASC}]) { uid predicateClass valueNumber unitCode massBasis amountReferent statedAsOf statedAsOfPrecision object { __typename ... on ChemicalSubstance { uid } ... on Organization { uid } } } }

name: T6d uid is selectable on the archetype interface (W00-R-05): adjudication considersAssessments returns uid without inline fragments
